heading_path: Buyer's Guide Cancel or reissue a solicitation - When to cancel or reissue
Buyer's Guide
blocks.markdown: When to cancel or reissue a solicitation You may cancel and reissue a solicitation if: a contract, standing offer, or supply arrangement hasn’t been issued and: a significant change has occurred in the requirement, or the acceptance period for the offer has expired one of the following applies, in which case the trade agreements allow the limited tendering procedure to be applied if the solicitation is reissued: no offers are compliant no offers represent fair value no offers were received in response to a competitive solicitation You must cancel a competitive solicitation if no compliant offers are received. A reminder that you are responsible for internal distribution of solicitations and updates within Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) and to the client. Anytime a solicitation is cancelled or reissued, you must document the procurement file accordingly, including the rationale for the decision.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Cancel or reissue a solicitation - When to cancel or reissue
Buyer's Guide
When to cancel or reissue a solicitation
blocks.markdown:
- a contract, standing offer, or supply arrangement hasn’t been issued and:
- a significant change has occurred in the requirement, or
- the acceptance period for the offer has expired
- one of the following applies, in which case the trade agreements allow the limited tendering procedure to be applied if the solicitation is reissued:
- no offers are compliant
- no offers represent fair value
- no offers were received in response to a competitive solicitation
